name: web writable stream
source: import { WritableStream } from 'node:stream/web'; async function main(): Promise<void> { const values: string[] = []; const stream = new WritableStream({ write(chunk) { values.push(String(chunk)); }, close() { values.push('closed'); } }); const writer = stream.getWriter(); await writer.write('hello'); await writer.close(); console.log(values.join(',')); }
